description: Stats for one Instagram post or reel, or one TikTok video: likes, comments, views, shares, saves, caption, hashtags, mentions, date, duration, music, author and engagement rates. Use when you have a link to one Instagram post or reel, or one TikTok video, and need its numbers: to report how a post performed, check a creator's claim, or track a campaign post. Returns platform, url, type, caption, hashtags[], mentions[], date, author {handle, name, followers, verified}, likes, comments, views, shares, saves, durationSeconds, music, location, viewEngagementRate and engagementRate. Likes hidden by the owner come back null. Private or removed posts fail and are not charged. For a whole account use social_instagram or social_tiktok. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.
